name: Energy Realasset (low-breakeven oil-sands + refining hedge)
thesis: Suncor is a low-corporate-breakeven oil-sands operator (sustaining capex + dividend covered around the mid-$40s WTI) whose integrated refining arm cushions crude-supply shocks, paired with Exxon as a larger, better-diversified integrated major. The pitch is a fair, real-oil-beta carry: roughly a mid-single-digit dividend plus buybacks that lift total shareholder yield toward the high single digits when oil cooperates. It is priced as a cyclical energy holding, not a defensive one: the yield, FCF and share price all move with the oil path, the refining hedge protects supply shocks but not demand recessions, and both names are entering near 52-week highs after large YTD runs, so the margin of safety is thin and this is a starter/tranche position rather than a full-weight defensive anchor.
